en.t: The woman brought over the meal.
There was braised fish and fresh shellfish soup.

units.source_text: 的确是海边风味的菜，这倒可以吃得惯，

en.t: It certainly had the flavor of the seaside, and this at least was something he could get used to eating,

units.source_text: 奇怪的是，他刚开始用餐，女人又跑过来为他撑开一把大伞。

en.t: The strange thing was that just as he began to eat, the woman ran over again and opened a large umbrella for him.
